words.tr: 短语. 一小部分；少部分
words.ex: He paid a fraction of the price.
words.ex_cn: 他只付了价格的一小部分。
words.en: A very small part or amount of something.

words.tr: phrase. 令人关切的事情；值得关注的问题
words.ex: The pollution in the river is a matter of concern.
words.ex_cn: 河流中的污染是一个令人担忧的问题。
words.en: Something that is important and requires attention or consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 一连串的；一系列；一套
words.ex: He made a series of mistakes on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一连串的错误。
words.en: A number of things or events that are arranged or happen one after the other.

words.tr: phrase. 最重要；首先
words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.

words.tr: phrase. 缺席的，不在场的；缺乏的，不存在的
words.ex: He was absent from class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了课程。
words.en: not present in a place, at an occasion, or as part of something

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.tr: phrase. 指责某人做某事
words.ex: He accused his friend of stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他指责他的朋友偷了钱。
words.en: If you accuse someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you say or tell them that you believe that they did it.

words.tr: phrase. 对…起作用；按...行动
words.ex: He acted on the advice and got better.
words.ex_cn: 他按照建议做了，结果好多了。
words.en: To do something as a result of information or advice received.

words.tr: phrase. 将...付诸行动；把…表演出来
words.ex: He didn't just talk about the plan—he decided to act it out.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅仅谈论这个计划，他还决定将它付诸行动。
words.en: To perform something, such as a play or a story, especially by acting; to express thoughts or feelings through actions.

words.tr: phrase. 合计达
words.ex: The numbers add up to 100.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字加起来等于100。
words.en: If amounts add up to a particular total, they result in that total when they are put together.

words.tr: phrase. 毕竟；终究
words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

words.tr: phrase. 在 ... 前面
words.ex: He is ahead of his classmates in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上比同学领先。
words.en: In front of or before something in time or space.

words.tr: phrase. v. 旨在；针对；以…为目标
words.ex: This program aims at helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目旨在帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you aim at something, you direct your efforts or actions towards achieving it.

words.tr: phrase. 突然；同时；一下子
words.ex: The lights went out all at once.
words.ex_cn: 灯一下子全灭了。
words.en: Suddenly; at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 突然
words.ex: All of a sudden, the dog started barking.
words.ex_cn: 突然间，狗开始叫了。
words.en: If something happens all of a sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 到处；四处；完了
words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；允许有；留出
words.ex: The plan allows for extra time if needed.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划为需要时留出了额外的时间。
words.en: To make provision or plans for something; to take into consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 总计
words.ex: The savings amount to $500.
words.ex_cn: 这些储蓄加起来是500美元。
words.en: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total. If an idea, feeling, or action amounts to something, it has the same effect or importance as that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 对…负责；因…而受罚 ；为…担保
words.ex: He will answer for his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他将为自己的错误负责。
words.en: If you answer for something, you are responsible for it and may be blamed or punished if it goes wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 远离；除...之外
words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.tr: phrase. 适用于；运用
words.ex: This rule applies to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 起于；由…引起
words.ex: The problem arises from a simple mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于一个简单的错误。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises from a particular event or activity, it is caused by it.

words.tr: phrase. 事实上
words.ex: I thought he was late, but as a matter of fact, he is early.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上，他来早了。
words.en: You use as a matter of fact to introduce a statement that gives more details about what has just been said, or an explanation of it, or something that contrasts with it.

words.tr: phrase. 通常
words.ex: As a rule, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 通常，他走路去学校。
words.en: If you say that something happens as a rule, you mean that it usually happens.

words.tr: phrase. 如下
words.ex: The steps are as follows.
words.ex_cn: 步骤如下。
words.en: used to introduce a list of items or points

words.tr: phrase. 关于；至于
words.ex: As for homework, I finished it yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 至于作业，我昨天就完成了。
words.en: used to start talking about someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something appears or behaves, suggesting that the appearance or behavior is not real or true

words.tr: phrase. 关于；就……而言
words.ex: As regards homework, I finish it every day.
words.ex_cn: 关于作业，我每天都完成。
words.en: You use 'as regards' to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.tr: phrase. 不包括；除…以外
words.ex: Aside from John, everyone went to the party.
words.ex_cn: 不包括约翰，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use aside from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: 短语. 一眼就能看出； glance 表示一瞥，at a glance 意为 glance 一下就能明白，即立刻理解或看出
words.ex: I can understand the chart at a glance.
words.ex_cn: 我一眼就能看懂这个图表。
words.en: If you see something at a glance, you see or recognize it immediately, often without looking carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 困惑；不知所措；亏本地
words.ex: He was at a loss when the teacher asked him a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师问他问题时，他不知所措。
words.en: If you say that you are at a loss, you mean that you do not know what to do in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 不惜任何代价；无论如何
words.ex: He will finish the project at all costs.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会不惜一切代价完成这个项目。
words.en: If you say that something must be done at all costs, you are emphasizing that it must be done, even if this requires a lot of effort or causes a lot of problems.

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；总之；不管怎样
words.ex: At all events, he will come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 无论如何，他都会来参加派对。
words.en: In any case; whatever happens.

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；不惜任何代价
words.ex: He was determined to win the competition at any price.
words.ex_cn: 他决心不惜任何代价赢得比赛。
words.en: If you say that you want something or would do something at any price, you are emphasizing that you want it or would do it very much, and would be willing to do anything in order to get it or do it.

words.tr: phrase. 无论如何；至少
words.ex: I don't like the movie, but at any rate, it was short.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这部电影，但无论如何，它很短。
words.en: Used to indicate that a statement is true or relevant in any case.

words.tr: phrase. 至多；充其量；顶多
words.ex: He is at best a beginner in cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在烹饪方面最多是个初学者。
words.en: At best is used to indicate the most positive or optimistic scenario or outcome, often implying that the actual situation may be worse.

words.tr: 短语. 轻松的；不拘束的；稍息（军事口令）
words.ex: He feels at ease when he is with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 当他和朋友在一起时，他感到轻松自在。
words.en: If you are at ease, you are feeling confident and relaxed, and are able to talk to people without feeling nervous or awkward.

words.tr: phrase. 乍看之下；一见就
words.ex: At first sight, the puzzle looks easy.
words.ex_cn: 乍一看，这个拼图很简单。
words.en: If you say that something seems to have a particular quality at first sight, you mean that it seems to have that quality when you first see it or first think about it, but that it may not really have that quality.

words.tr: phrase. 全速地；全力地；以最大音量或强度
words.ex: The music was playing at full blast, making it hard to concentrate.
words.ex_cn: 音乐以最大音量播放，让人难以集中注意力。
words.en: At full blast means at maximum volume or intensity.

words.tr: phrase. 在手边；在附近；即将到来
words.ex: The solution is at hand.
words.ex_cn: 解决办法就在眼前。
words.en: If something is at hand, it is nearby or about to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 不时；相隔一定距离（或时间）
words.ex: He checks the machine at intervals.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一段时间检查一下机器。
words.en: If something happens at intervals, it happens occasionally or periodically, with breaks in between.

words.tr: phrase. 一般的；普遍；未被捕；详尽
words.ex: The issue is important at large.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题在一般情况下很重要。
words.en: If someone dangerous is at large, they are not in prison or have not been caught. It also means discussing something in a general way without considering details.

words.tr: phrase. 有空；悠闲地；从容地
words.ex: He reads books at leisure on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末闲暇时读书。
words.en: If you do something at leisure, you do it in a relaxed way or at the time that you want, rather than in a hurried or forced way.

words.tr: phrase. 最后；详尽地
words.ex: He talked at length about his trip finally.
words.ex_cn: 他最后详细谈到了他的旅行。
words.en: If someone does something at length, they do it for a long time or in great detail.

words.tr: phrase. 至多；最多
words.ex: You can have at most three cookies.
words.ex_cn: 你最多只能吃三块饼干。
words.en: You use at most or at the most to say that a number or amount is the maximum that is possible and that the actual number or amount may be smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 从不；在任何时候都不
words.ex: At no time did he lie to his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从未对父母撒过谎。
words.en: If you say that at no time did a particular thing happen, you are emphasizing that it never happened.

words.tr: phrase. 任某人处理；供某人支配
words.ex: The car is at your disposal after 6 PM.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在下午6点后由你支配。
words.en: Available for someone to use as they wish.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为代价
words.ex: He succeeded at the cost of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但以牺牲健康为代价。
words.en: If something is achieved at the cost of something else, it is achieved by losing the other thing or by causing it to be lost.

words.tr: phrase. 在损害...的情况下
words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但牺牲了自己的健康。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is done in a way that harms them or is unfair to them.

words.tr: phrase. 受…支配；任…摆布
words.ex: The boat was at the mercy of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 船听任风暴摆布。
words.en: If one person or thing is at the mercy of another, the first person or thing is in a situation where they cannot prevent themselves being harmed or affected by the second.

words.tr: phrase. 照这样的速度；照这样下去
words.ex: At this rate, we will finish the work tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 照这样下去，我们明天就能完成工作。
words.en: If you say that something is happening at a particular rate, you mean that it is continuing or developing at that speed.

words.tr: phrase. 随心所欲地；随意地
words.ex: He can leave at will.
words.ex_cn: 他可以随时离开。
words.en: If you can do something at will, you can do it when you want and in the way that you want.

words.tr: phrase. 来回地；一来一往
words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 让步；退缩；放弃原先的立场或要求
words.ex: He won't back down even when he's wrong.
words.ex_cn: 即使他错了，他也不会退让。
words.en: To withdraw from a commitment or position, often in the face of opposition or after a confrontation.

words.tr: phrase. 在...后部；在…背部
words.ex: The book is on the back of the chair.
words.ex_cn: 书在椅子的背面。
words.en: prep. If something is at the back of a place or thing, it is in a position where it cannot be seen because it is behind something else.

words.tr: phrase. 支持；倒退；备份
words.ex: My friend always backs up my ideas in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 我的朋友总是在会议上支持我的想法。
words.en: To support someone or something; to make a copy of computer data to protect against loss.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎没有；缺乏
words.ex: The ground is bare of grass.
words.ex_cn: 地面没有草。
words.en: Lacking or stripped of something, especially a covering or decoration.

words.tr: phrase. 能够做某事；有能力完成
words.ex: She will be able to attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她将能够参加明天的会议。
words.en: To have the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 富于；有丰富的…
words.ex: This forest is abundant in birds and trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林里鸟和树很多。
words.en: To exist in large quantities or be plentiful within a specific place or context.

words.tr: phrase. 对…来说陌生的；与…格格不入的；不符合…的性质的
words.ex: The concept of democracy is alien to many people in that country.
words.ex_cn: 民主的概念对那个国家的许多人来说是陌生的。
words.en: If something is alien to you, it is not familiar to you or it is not something you would normally do or think.

words.tr: phrase. 在附近；在...身边；围绕
words.ex: My brother is around after school.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥放学后在家。
words.en: If someone or something is around, they are present in a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 可被...利用或得到的
words.ex: The new software will be available to the public next month.
words.ex_cn: 这款新软件将于下个月对公众开放使用。
words.en: If something is available to someone, they are able to use it or obtain it.

words.tr: phrase. 一定；注定
words.ex: He is tired, so he is bound to fall asleep soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，所以很快就会睡着。
words.en: Certain or destined to happen; inevitably going to occur.

words.tr: phrase. 能够
words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决困难的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability, power, or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase.  涉及；关切；与…有关
words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.tr: phrase. 极想做某事；迫切希望；非常渴望
words.ex_cn: 他急着想看他的新手机。
words.en: If you say that you are dying for something or are dying to do something, you mean that you want to have it or do it very much.

words.tr: phrase. 对...感到厌烦；受够了...
words.ex: He is fed up with doing the same work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的工作。
words.en: To be bored, annoyed, or unhappy, especially with a situation that has existed for a long time.

words.tr: 短语动词. 正当令的；正当时节的（指水果、蔬菜等在自然成熟的季节中，供应充足且价格较低）
words.ex: Strawberries are in season now, so they are cheaper.
words.ex_cn: v. 草莓现在正当时令，所以更便宜。
words.en: If a food is in season, it is the time of year when it is naturally available and ready to eat.

words.tr: phrase. 时间紧迫；时间不够用
words.ex: I can't talk right now, I'm really pressed for time.
words.ex_cn: 我现在不能谈话，我真的时间很紧。
words.en: To have very little time available to do something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 忙于……；被……缠住；与……有密切关联
words.ex: He is tied up with work today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天忙于工作。
words.en: To be closely involved with something or busy with something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 避开人群；赶在人群之前行动
words.ex: We left early to beat the crowd at the concert.
words.ex_cn: v. 我们早早离开以避开音乐会的人群。
words.en: To avoid the crowd by arriving early or taking a different route.

words.tr: phrase. 一心想要做某事的；决心要获得某物的
words.ex: He is bent on winning the race.
words.ex_cn: 他一心想要赢得比赛。
words.en: Determined to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 离题的；不相关的；与正题无关的
words.ex: His opinion is beside point in this discussion.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见在这次讨论中无关紧要。
words.en: Not relevant to the matter at hand; off-topic.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问地；确实地
words.ex: He is the best player, beyond question.
words.ex_cn: 他是最棒的球员，毫无疑问。
words.en: If something is beyond question, it is completely certain and everyone accepts it.

words.tr: phrase. 前往…的；开往…的（通常指有明确目的地的行程）
words.ex: The ship is bound for New York.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船正前往纽约。
words.en: Heading towards a specified place.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；（使）逐渐适用
words.ex: Thieves broke in through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从后门闯入。
words.en: To enter a building by force, especially in order to steal something; to interrupt a conversation or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；突然…
words.ex: The thief tried to break into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图在夜里闯入房子。
words.en: To enter a building or car using force, in order to steal something; to suddenly start doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.tr: phrase. 突发；爆发；越狱
words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 突破；克服；突围
words.ex: The scientists are trying to break though the limitations of current technology.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们正试图突破当前技术的限制。
words.en: To make a significant and sudden advance, especially in knowledge or technique.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.tr: phrase. 使信服；使复苏
words.ex: He brought his friend around to the new idea slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地让朋友接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To persuade someone to agree with you or to do what you want; to cause someone to regain consciousness; to cause someone to change their opinion or decision.

words.tr: phrase. 使降低；击落；击败
words.ex: The new policy will bring down prices.
words.ex_cn: 新政策将降低价格。
words.en: To cause something to fall or collapse; to reduce the level or amount of something; to cause someone in a position of power to lose their position.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；产生；生出；使显现
words.ex: He brought forth a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To bring forth means to produce or cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 把…拿进来；介绍引进；赚（钱）
words.ex: Can you bring in the books from the car?
words.ex_cn: 你能把车里的书拿进来吗？
words.en: To introduce something new or to cause something to happen.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 成功完成（困难的事情）；使（计划、交易等）成功
words.ex: He brought off the magic show with great skill.
words.ex_cn: 他以高超的技巧完成了这场魔术表演。
words.en: To successfully achieve something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 引起；导致；使发展
words.ex: The heat can bring on a headache.
words.ex_cn: 炎热会引发头痛。
words.en: To cause something to happen or to lead to a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 使表现出；说出；呈出；出版
words.ex: The new lighting really brings out the colors in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 新灯光让画中的颜色更加突出。
words.en: To cause something to be seen or known; to publish something.

words.tr: phrase. 使恢复知觉
words.ex: The nurse poured cold water on his face to bring him to.
words.ex_cn: 护士往他脸上泼了冷水，让他苏醒过来。
words.en: To cause someone to regain consciousness or to become aware of something.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然地；意外地
words.ex: He broke the vase by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If something happens by accident, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 尽一切办法；务必；一定
words.ex: You can borrow my book by all means.
words.ex_cn: 你当然可以借我的书。
words.en: used to give permission or to say that you are willing to allow something to happen

words.tr: phrase. 碰巧；偶然；意外地
words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；因为
words.ex: He was excused by reason of his illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因病被原谅了。
words.en: Because of; due to.

words.tr: phrase. 凭借…的力量；由于
words.ex: He passed the test by virtue of his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: Because of or as a result of something.

words.tr: phrase. 经由；作为；为了
words.ex: He sent the letter by way of his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他通过朋友寄了这封信。
words.en: If you do something by way of a particular method, you use that method to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 回电话；回访；召回
words.ex: He will call back after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会回电话。
words.en: To telephone someone again, especially in order to give them some information or because they were not available when you telephoned before.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 叫（某人）进来；召来；来访
words.ex: He called in a doctor for his sick son.
words.ex_cn: 他为生病的儿子请了一位医生。
words.en: To request someone's presence or participation, especially by telephone.

words.tr: phrase. 取消；转移；叫走；依次叫名
words.ex: They decided to call off the meeting because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为风暴决定取消会议。
words.en: To cancel or abandon something that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 给…打电话；使想起；召集
words.ex: He called up his friend to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友打电话问好。
words.en: To telephone someone; to summon someone to military service; to bring something back to one's mind.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 成功地处理或应对（困难或尴尬的情况）；夺走；使显得有魅力
words.ex: He carried off the awkward silence with a joke.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个笑话成功应对了尴尬的沉默。
words.en: To succeed in doing or achieving something, especially something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 执行；进行；履行
words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr: phrase. （使）延续；（使）延伸；延期至...
words.ex: We can carry over the unused vacation days to next year.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以把未用完的假期天数延到明年。
words.en: To transfer or extend something from one time or place to another.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 坚持到底；完成；帮助某人渡过难关
words.ex: He worked hard to carry through his plan.
words.ex_cn: 他努力实施他的计划。
words.en: To complete something or to continue doing something until it is finished, especially something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. v. 试图抓住；急切地抓住（机会、希望等）
words.ex: He tried to catch at the rope as it slipped away.
words.ex_cn: 当绳子滑走时，他试图抓住它。
words.en: To try to seize or grasp something eagerly.

words.tr: phrase. 着火
words.ex: The paper caught fire quickly.
words.ex_cn: 纸很快着火了。
words.en: To begin to burn; to ignite.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住；抓紧；握住
words.ex: He tried to catch hold on the rope but missed.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住绳子，但没抓住。
words.en: To grasp or seize something with the hands.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；明白；变得流行
words.ex: He didn't understand the joke at first, but then he caught on.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始没明白这个笑话，但后来明白了。
words.en: To understand or become popular.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使某人措手不及；发现某人做错事；使某人陷入困境
words.ex: The teacher's question caught me out because I didn't study.
words.ex_cn: 老师的问题让我措手不及，因为我没学习。
words.en: To discover someone doing something wrong or making a mistake, especially when they are trying to deceive you.

words.tr: phrase. 看见；瞥见
words.ex: I caught sight of a bird flying over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看见一只鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: If you catch sight of someone or something, you see them suddenly or briefly.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；逮捕并处罚；（麻烦事）缠上
words.ex: He needs to catch up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他需要赶上他的同学。
words.en: To reach the same standard or level as someone or something else, especially after a period of lagging behind.

words.tr: phrase. 指控某人做某事；控告某人某罪名
words.ex: The police charged him with theft.
words.ex_cn: 警察指控他盗窃。
words.en: To formally accuse someone of a crime or wrongdoing.

words.tr: phrase. 偶遇；偶然发现；使产生…印象
words.ex: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.
words.ex_cn: 我在打扫房间时发现了一张旧照片。
words.en: If you come across something or someone, you find them or meet them by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.tr: phrase. v. （观点或态度）改变，回心转意；顺便来访，顺道拜访；苏醒，恢复知觉
words.ex: At first he refused, but later he came around and agreed to help.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始拒绝了，但后来回心转意，同意帮忙。
words.en: To change one's opinion or decision; to regain consciousness; to visit someone casually.

words.tr: phrase. v. 获得；设法得到；顺道来访
words.ex: I came by some old books at the flea market.
words.ex_cn: 我在跳蚤市场弄到了一些旧书。
words.en: To obtain or acquire something, especially something that is not easily available.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 下来；下降；流传；病倒
words.ex: The price of apples came down last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周苹果的价格降了。
words.en: To move or travel from a higher to a lower level or position; to descend.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 受到（批评、赞扬等）；招致
words.ex: He came in for criticism after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因这个错误而受到了批评。
words.en: If someone or something comes in for criticism, blame, or praise, they receive it.

words.tr: phrase. 形成；产生
words.ex: The company came into being in 2010.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司成立于2010年。
words.en: To begin to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；举行；实现；成功；从…掉下
words.ex: He will come off the train at the next station.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下一站下车。
words.en: To happen or occur, especially in a particular way; to be successful or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；出来；出版
words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: phrase. 到达；显现；实现；成功地完成；（健康）恢复；渡过
words.ex: The package will come through tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 包裹明天会到达。
words.en: To successfully deal with a difficult situation or to do what is needed or expected.

words.tr: phrase. 实现；成真
words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 面对；遭遇（困难、反对等）
words.ex: He came up against a big problem while solving the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时遇到了一个大问题。
words.en: To encounter or face difficulties or opposition.

words.tr: phrase. 达到；符合
words.ex: The temperature came up to 30 degrees yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度升到了30度。
words.en: To reach a particular standard or level; to be as good as expected.

words.tr: phrase. 赶上；提出；想出
words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 发生；上来；提到
words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 倒数；倒计时
words.ex: They count down from ten to one.
words.ex_cn: 他们从十倒数到一。
words.en: A count down is a period during which the remaining time is announced at regular intervals before an event occurs.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；指望
words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.tr: phrase. 削减；急忙返回
words.ex: He wants to cut back on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他想减少糖的摄入。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, cost, etc. of something.

words.tr: phrase. 砍倒；削减；杀死
words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: phrase. 插嘴；打断；超车抢档
words.ex: He cut in while I was talking.
words.ex_cn: 我正在说话时，他插嘴了。
words.en: To interrupt someone who is speaking, or to move into a line of traffic by driving in front of someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 切断；使隔绝；剪下
words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.tr: phrase. 切掉；裁剪出；停止
words.ex: He cut out sugar from his diet.
words.ex_cn: 他从饮食中戒掉了糖。
words.en: To remove something by cutting it or to stop doing something.

words.tr: 短语动词，经营，从事（某种商品的买卖）
words.ex: He deals in used cars.
words.ex_cn: 他经营二手车。
words.en: To deal in something means to buy and sell it as a business.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐消失；变弱
words.ex: The sound of the bell died away slowly.
words.ex_cn: 铃声渐渐消失了。
words.en: If a sound dies away, it gradually becomes weaker or quieter and then stops completely.

words.tr: phrase.  灭绝；逐渐消失
words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.tr: phrase. 充分体现…的价值；公正地对待；如实评价
words.ex: This painting does justice to the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画充分展现了自然的美。
words.en: To treat or represent someone or something in a way that is fair and shows their true qualities.

words.tr: 短语动词. 洗衣服
words.ex: She does the laundry every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周日洗衣服。
words.en: To wash clothes, sheets, and other items using a washing machine or by hand.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 顺便访问；顺道拜访
words.ex: I will drop by your house after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去你家拜访。
words.en: To visit someone casually and usually without having arranged it before.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （消息等）传开；（人）走动，外出活动
words.ex: The news about the party got about quickly.
words.ex_cn: 关于派对的消息很快传开了。
words.en: To move around or travel, especially within a community or area.

words.tr: phrase. 被理解；讲清楚
words.ex: He tried to get across his idea simply.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简单地表达他的想法。
words.en: To succeed in communicating an idea or piece of information to someone, especially when this is difficult or complicated.

words.tr: phrase. v. 取得成功；进步；超越他人
words.ex: He works hard to get ahead in his job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以在工作中取得进步。
words.en: To make progress or become successful in one's career or life.

words.tr: phrase. 相处；进展
words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.tr: phrase. 逃脱；离开；度假
words.ex: The thief tried to get away from the police.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图逃脱警察。
words.en: If you get away, you succeed in leaving a place or a person's company. If you get away with something, you succeed in doing it without being caught or punished.

words.tr: phrase. 回来；取回；恢复；报复
words.ex: He will get back tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会回来。
words.en: To return to a place, condition, or activity; to recover something lost or taken away; to retaliate.

words.tr: phrase. v. 度过难关；勉强应付；勉强维持生活
words.ex: He gets by with little money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠很少的钱维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have.

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；到达；插话；收割；当选
words.ex: He gets in the car every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上车。
words.en: To arrive at a place, especially after a journey.

words.tr: phrase. 下车；离开
words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.tr: phrase. 出去；离开
words.ex: He told the dog to get out.
words.ex_cn: 他让狗出去。
words.en: To leave or escape from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 克服；恢复；原谅
words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.tr: phrase. 投降；屈服；让步
words.ex: He will not give in to the bully.
words.ex_cn: 他不会向欺凌者屈服。
words.en: To agree to something that you had been opposing, especially because someone has forced or persuaded you to.

words.tr: phrase. 发出（蒸汽、光等）
words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 引起；导致
words.ex: Poor hygiene can give rise to infections.
words.ex_cn: 不良的卫生习惯可能导致感染。
words.en: To cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 着手干；进行；（经常）表现得
words.ex: He goes about his work quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地做自己的工作。
words.en: If you go about a task or problem in a particular way, you start dealing with it in that way.

words.tr: phrase. 追逐；追求
words.ex: He goes after his dreams every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天追求自己的梦想。
words.en: To pursue or chase someone or something, often with the intention of catching or achieving them.

words.tr: phrase. 反对；违反；不利于
words.ex: If you go against the rules, you might get in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规定，可能会惹上麻烦。
words.en: To oppose or act in contradiction to something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 前进；继续；进行
words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 一起去；赞同；附和
words.ex: I will go along with you to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我会和你一起去公园。
words.en: To agree with or support someone or something; to accompany someone.

words.tr: 参观; 转动; 走访; 相处
words.ex: We went around the old town last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们参观了老城区。
words.en: If you go around to someone's house, you visit them. If a story or piece of information goes around, it is told or passed on to a lot of people. If there is enough of something to go around, there is enough for everyone to have some.

words.tr: phrase. （时间）过去；逝去；走过
words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；爱好；从事；赞成
words.ex: He goes in for football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都参加足球。
words.en: To participate in or be involved with something; to have a liking for something.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 把...传下来；宣布
words.ex: My grandmother will hand down her old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖母会把她的旧表传给我。
words.en: To pass something from one generation to the next or to officially give a decision or judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 交上；提交；呈递
words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.tr: phrase. v. 传递；交给（某人）
words.ex: Please hand on the book to your friend.
words.ex_cn: 请把书递给你的朋友。
words.en: To pass something to someone else, especially so that they can take over a responsibility or duty.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；给予
words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 交出； 交付
words.ex: He will hand over the keys tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会交出钥匙。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially because you have been ordered to do so or because it is necessary.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 闲逛；徘徊；无所事事地待着
words.ex: They like to hang about after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢放学后闲逛。
words.en: To spend time somewhere without any real purpose or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 挂断；拖延；把...挂起来
words.ex: He hung up the phone after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵后，他挂断了电话。
words.en: To end a telephone conversation by breaking the connection; to suspend something from above so that it is supported only from above.

words.tr: phrase. 发生在...人身上；碰巧
words.ex: What will happen to the dog if we go on vacation?
words.ex_cn: 如果我们去度假，那只狗会怎么样？
words.en: If something happens to someone or something, it occurs or takes place, often by chance.

words.tr: phrase. v. 抑制，压制；保住（工作）；按住，使固定
words.ex: Try to hold down your anger.
words.ex_cn: 试着抑制你的愤怒。
words.en: To keep something at a low level or to maintain a position or job despite difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.tr: phrase. 除…之外
words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.tr: phrase. 提前；预先
words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 简单地说；简而言之；简单扼要地
words.ex: In brief, he likes soccer.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢足球。
words.en: In a few words; concisely.

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.tr: phrase. 负责；主管
words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: Having control over or responsibility for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 共有
words.ex: They have nothing in common.
words.ex_cn: 他们没有什么共同点。
words.en: If two or more people have something in common, they share the same interests or experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 总之；最后；综上所述
words.ex: In conclusion, we should eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 总之，我们应该多吃蔬菜。
words.en: used to introduce the final comments at the end of a speech or a piece of writing

words.tr: phrase. 因此；结果
words.ex: He forgot his homework, in consequence, he got a bad grade.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了做作业，结果得了低分。
words.en: As a result; therefore.

words.tr: phrase. 欠债
words.ex: He is in debt because he bought a car.
words.ex_cn: 他因为买了一辆车而欠债。
words.en: owing money to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 感到怀疑的；不能肯定的；存在疑问的
words.ex: I am in doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案感到不确定。
words.en: If you are in doubt, you are uncertain about something or unsure about what to do.

words.tr: phrase. 交换；以此易彼
words.ex: He gave me a book in exchange for a pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一本书换了我的钢笔。
words.en: If you give or do something in exchange for something else, you give or do it in order to get that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 面对；在…面前；不顾；即使
words.ex: In face of danger, he remained calm.
words.ex_cn: 面对危险，他保持冷静。
words.en: In the presence of or when confronted with something challenging or difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 赞成；支持
words.ex: He is in favour of eating more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favour of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协调一致；与...和谐
words.ex: The painting is in harmony with the room's colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与房间的颜色相协调。
words.en: If one thing is in harmony with another, the first thing suits the second or they seem right together.

words.tr: phrase. 为纪念；为庆祝
words.ex: A monument was built in honour of the soldiers who died in the war.
words.ex_cn: 为了纪念在战争中牺牲的士兵，建立了一座纪念碑。
words.en: If something is done in honour of a particular person or event, it is done to show respect or admiration for them.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.tr: phrase. 立刻；马上
words.ex: He finished his homework in no time.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就完成了作业。
words.en: Very quickly or soon.

words.tr: phrase. 代替
words.ex: He used honey in place of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他用蜂蜜代替了糖。
words.en: Instead of someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 实际上；事实上
words.ex: He looks happy, but in reality, he is sad.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来很开心，但事实上，他很难过。
words.en: used to emphasize what is actually the case, as opposed to what people might think

words.tr: phrase. 关于
words.ex: He spoke in regard to the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新的校规。
words.en: Concerning or about something.

words.tr: phrase. 作为...的报答
words.ex: He helped me, and I gave him a gift in return for it.
words.ex_cn: 他帮了我，我送他一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for something that someone has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.tr: phrase. 不顾；不管；尽管
words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr: phrase. 如果是那样的话；在那种情况下
words.ex: He didn't bring his book; in that case, I'll lend you mine.
words.ex_cn: 他没带书；那样的话，我借给你我的。
words.en: If that is the situation, then...

words.tr: phrase. 以……的形式；呈……形状；以……方式
words.ex: The answer is in the form of a number.
words.ex_cn: 答案是以数字的形式给出的。
words.en: used to indicate the way in which something is done or presented

words.tr: phrase. 从长远来看；最后
words.ex: In the long run, eating healthy saves money on doctor visits.
words.ex_cn: 从长远来看，健康饮食可以节省看医生的费用。
words.en: Over an extended period of time; in the future, especially in the distant future.

words.tr: phrase. 白费地； 徒劳地
words.ex: He cried in vain for help.
words.ex_cn: 他呼救却无济于事。
words.en: If you do something in vain, you do not succeed in achieving what you intend.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；隐瞒；留在后面
words.ex: He tried to keep back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To retain or withhold something, not allowing it to be seen, known, or used.

words.tr: phrase. 控制；镇压；缩减
words.ex: Please keep down the noise.
words.ex_cn: 请把噪音压低。
words.en: To prevent something from increasing, spreading, or becoming too noticeable.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；妨碍；抑制
words.ex: He tried to keep from crying.
words.ex_cn: 他努力忍住不哭。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something or to not do something oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持联系
words.ex: I keep in touch with my friend by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 让开；不接近
words.ex: Keep off the grass.
words.ex_cn: 别踩草坪。
words.en: To avoid touching, stepping on, or coming into contact with something; to prevent someone or something from coming near or touching something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续
words.ex: He keeps on walking even when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 即使累了，他还是继续走。
words.en: If you keep on doing something, you continue to do it and do not stop.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守诺言；守信用
words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守；遵循；坚持
words.ex: He keeps to his schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都遵守自己的日程。
words.en: To continue to do something or to stay in a particular state or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 击倒；拆卸；拍板成交；获得（收入）；降低（价格）；减（量）
words.ex: The strong wind can knock down the small tree.
words.ex_cn: 强风能把小树吹倒。
words.en: To knock someone or something down means to cause them to fall to the ground by hitting them, often with a vehicle or by physical force.

words.tr: phrase. 击倒；使失去知觉；淘汰；使震惊 adj. 击倒的；淘汰的 n. 淘汰赛；击倒；令人印象深刻的人或事物
words.ex: He cannot know out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他无法弄清楚答案。
words.en: A misspelling of 'knock out', meaning to render unconscious or to defeat decisively.

words.tr: phrase. 把……放在一边；搁置；储蓄；抛弃
words.ex: He lay aside his book and stood up.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在一边，站了起来。
words.en: To put something to one side, especially for a short time, in order to do something else.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；放弃；规定
words.ex: The soldiers were ordered to lay down their arms.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们被命令放下武器。
words.en: To lay something down means to put it down, often in a careful or deliberate way. It can also mean to establish something, such as rules or guidelines.

words.tr: phrase. 暂时解雇；停止
words.ex: The company will lay off 50 workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将裁员50人。
words.en: To terminate the employment of a worker or workers, especially temporarily, because there is not enough work for them to do.

words.tr: phrase. 摆开；展示；布置；安排；投资
words.ex: He will lay out the books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他将把书摆在桌子上。
words.en: To arrange or spread something out in a particular way, especially so that it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr: phrase. 不管；不理会；更不用说
words.ex: Leave him alone; he wants to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 别管他，他想安静一下。
words.en: To not disturb or bother someone; to allow someone to be by themselves.

words.tr: phrase. 留下；忘带；抛弃
words.ex: He left behind his book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书留在了桌子上。
words.en: To go away from a place without taking someone or something with you.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 回头看；回顾；倒退
words.ex: He looks back on his childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他满怀幸福地回忆自己的童年。
words.en: To look back means to think about something that happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 蔑视；瞧不起
words.ex: He looks down on people who work hard.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起努力工作的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.tr: phrase. 尊敬；仰慕；敬佩
words.ex: I look up to my teacher because she is kind and smart.
words.ex_cn: 我尊敬我的老师，因为她善良又聪明。
words.en: If you look up to someone, you respect and admire them.

words.tr: phrase. 努力；尽力；作出努力
words.ex: He makes an effort to wake up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力早起。
words.en: To attempt to do something, especially when it requires a significant amount of work or determination.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 弥补；补偿
words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.tr: phrase. 让路给；为…腾出空间；给…让位
words.ex: The old building was torn down to make way for a new park.
words.ex_cn: 旧建筑被拆除了，为新公园让路。
words.en: If you make way for someone or something, you move aside so that they can pass or so that there is space for them.

words.tr: phrase. 混合；混淆
words.ex: Don't mix up the red and blue paints.
words.ex_cn: 别把红色和蓝色的颜料弄混了。
words.en: To confuse or mistake one thing for another.

words.tr: phrase. 不时地；偶尔
words.ex: He visits his grandparents now and then.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.tr: phrase. 平均
words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.tr: phrase. 独自地；独立地；靠自己的力量
words.ex: He cooked dinner on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他独自做了晚饭。
words.en: Without help from others; independently.

words.tr: phrase. 与此相反；正相反
words.ex: He says he likes quiet, on the contrary, he always listens to loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢安静，相反，他总是听大声的音乐。
words.en: You use 'on the contrary' when you are contradicting what has just been said or implied, or making a contrast between two things.

words.tr: phrase. 配成一对
words.ex: The teacher asked the students to pair up for the activity.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们两人一组进行活动。
words.en: To join two people or things together, especially in order to work or do something together.

words.tr: phrase. 奋力向前；推进
words.ex: Despite the challenges, we must press forward with our plans.
words.ex_cn: 尽管面临挑战，我们必须继续推进我们的计划。
words.en: To continue moving or progressing in a determined way, especially in the face of difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 迫切要求
words.ex: They press for better working conditions.
words.ex_cn: 他们要求更好的工作条件。
words.en: To urge or demand something strongly and persistently.

words.tr: phrase. 用力压；加紧；强加于；坚持地继续
words.ex: He pressed on the button hard.
words.ex_cn: 他用力按了那个按钮。
words.en: To continue doing something in a determined way, despite difficulties or opposition.

words.tr: phrase. 拉回；撤退；收回；撤销
words.ex: The troops had to pull back to avoid heavy casualties.
words.ex_cn: 部队不得不撤退以避免重大伤亡。
words.en: To withdraw or retreat from a position or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 进站；靠岸；赚取
words.ex: The bus pulls in at the station every ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车每十分钟进站一次。
words.en: To attract or earn money; to arrest someone; (of a vehicle) to move into a particular place or to stop at a station.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. （把车）靠边停下；靠边停车
words.ex: The police told him to pull over.
words.ex_cn: 警察让他靠边停车。
words.en: To move a vehicle to the side of the road and stop, especially when instructed by the police.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 放回；推迟；延误
words.ex: Please put back the book on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 请把书放回书架上。
words.en: To return something to its original place or to postpone an event or action.

words.tr: phrase. 归因于
words.ex: He put his success down to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you put something down to a particular thing, you believe that it is caused by that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 提出
words.ex: He put forward a new idea in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个新想法。
words.en: To suggest or propose something for consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 延期；推迟
words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 扑灭；熄掉；伸出；发表；恼怒
words.ex: He put out the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他用毯子扑灭了火。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or light; to publish or produce something; to extend or stretch out something.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖；依靠
words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；搁在；停留在；基于
words.ex: The bridge must rest on strong pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥必须依靠坚固的支柱。
words.en: To depend or rely on something for support or as a basis.

words.tr: phrase. 导致
words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；着手
words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 阻碍；延缓；使受挫折；回拨（钟表）
words.ex: The storm set back the construction by two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴把施工推迟了两周。
words.en: To delay or hinder the progress of something.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 炫耀；卖弄
words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.tr: phrase. 露面；到场；显现
words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 迄今为止
words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.tr: phrase. 避开；不参与；远离（某地或某事）
words.ex: He decided to stay out of the argument to avoid any conflict.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参与争论，以避免任何冲突。
words.en: To avoid becoming involved in something; to keep away from a particular situation or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 留宿；过夜
words.ex: They decided to stay over at a friend's house.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定在朋友家过夜。
words.en: To spend the night at a place that is not your home.

words.tr: phrase. 熬夜；不睡觉
words.ex: He stays up late to watch movies.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜看电影。
words.en: To remain awake and not go to bed.

words.tr: phrase.  进入；干涉；介入；作短时访问
words.ex: He will step in to help when needed.
words.ex_cn: 当需要时，他会介入帮忙。
words.en: To become involved in a situation in order to help deal with a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 走出；暂时离开；外出（尤指短暂地）
words.ex: She decided to step out for a quick breath of fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她决定出去呼吸一下新鲜空气。
words.en: To walk out of a place, especially briefly or suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 增加；提升；加紧；走上前
words.ex: He will step up to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他将挺身而出帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To increase the amount, speed, or intensity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持做；紧跟；紧随
words.ex: I will stick with this plan.
words.ex_cn: 我会坚持这个计划。
words.en: To continue to support or use something, even though it may be difficult or you may want to change to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 合计；总计；概括
words.ex: Can you sum up the total cost?
words.ex_cn: 你能合计一下总费用吗？
words.en: If you sum something up, you briefly describe the main features or ideas of it.

words.tr: phrase. 从更长远角度来看
words.ex: We need to take a longer view of our environmental policies.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要从长远的角度来看待我们的环境政策。
words.en: To consider something in terms of its long-term effects or implications.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑
words.ex: The teacher must take account of each student's speed.
words.ex_cn: 老师必须考虑每个学生的进度。
words.en: To consider or pay attention to something when making a decision or judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 与 ... 相像；效仿
words.ex: He takes after his father in looks.
words.ex_cn: 他在长相上像他父亲。
words.en: If you take after a member of your family, you resemble them in your appearance, your behaviour, or your character.

words.tr: phrase. 冒风险
words.ex: He takes a risk to start his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒险创办自己的公司。
words.en: To engage in an action with the possibility of loss or failure; to take a chance.

words.tr: phrase. 利用；欺骗；占便宜
words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 瞄准；针对；把…作为目标
words.ex: He takes aim at the target with a bow and arrow.
words.ex_cn: 他用弓箭瞄准目标。
words.en: To direct one's effort or attention towards a particular target or goal.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸； 拆开
words.ex: He took apart the clock to see how it works.
words.ex_cn: 他把钟表拆开来看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into its different parts, especially in order to repair it or to understand how it works.

words.tr: phrase. 拿回；收回；取消；使回忆起
words.ex: I will take back my book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我会从图书馆拿回我的书。
words.en: To take something back means to return something to the place it came from, or to admit that something you said was wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 控制；掌管
words.ex: He decided to take control of his life.
words.ex_cn: 他决定掌控自己的生活。
words.en: To take control of something means to gain the power or authority to manage or direct it.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸；拆毁；记录；记下；笔录；取下
words.ex: He took down the old photo from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧照片取了下来。
words.en: To write something down, especially in order to remember or record it; to remove something from a high position; to dismantle or disassemble something.

words.tr: phrase. 生效；开始起作用
words.ex: The new rule will take effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将在下周一生效。
words.en: If something takes effect, it begins to produce results or to work.

words.tr: phrase. 认为…是理所当然
words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or to exist without needing proof or evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 接管；接任；取代
words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拿出钥匙开门。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.tr: phrase. 发生
words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. 趋向；易于；往往
words.ex: He tends to arrive late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是迟到上课。
words.en: If someone or something tends to do a particular thing, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.tr: phrase. 在一定程度上
words.ex: To a certain extent, his absence was felt by the team.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他的缺席让团队感到了影响。
words.en: To some degree; partly.

words.tr: phrase. 连同；一起
words.ex: He plays soccer together with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: In addition to someone or something else; alongside.

words.tr: phrase. 击败；成功；得胜
words.ex: He triumphed over fear and gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 他战胜了恐惧，发表了演讲。
words.en: to achieve a victory over; to overcome

words.tr: phrase. 试穿；试验
words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.ex_cn: 她想试穿那条新裙子。
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.tr: phrase. 初次尝试；试试身手
words.ex: He tries his hand at painting on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末试着画画。
words.en: To attempt to do something, especially for the first time.

words.tr: phrase. 碰运气；试试运气
words.ex: He goes to the market to try his luck every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末都去市场碰运气。
words.en: To attempt something with the hope of success, especially when the outcome is uncertain.

words.tr: phrase. 悬而未决的；未确定的；不确定的
words.ex: The plans are up in the air.
words.ex_cn: 计划还未确定。
words.en: If a matter is up in the air, it is uncertain, often because other matters have to be decided first.

words.tr: phrase. 最近的；最新的
words.ex: He keeps his knowledge up to date.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己的知识保持最新。
words.en: If something is up to date, it is the newest thing of its kind.
